settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Your profile, how clients see your galleries, notifications and security.
settings.loadFailed: Check your connection and try again.
settings.saveFailed: That didn't save. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
settings.networkError: No connection. Check your internet and try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name and studio appear in the app and on the galleries you share.
profile.photoHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 15 MB. A square photo works best.
profile.removePhotoBody: Your initials show instead until you upload a new one.
profile.name: Full name
profile.studioHint: Clients see this name on your galleries. Leave it empty to use your full name.
profile.phoneHint: Clients reach you on WhatsApp at this number.
profile.bioHint: A few lines for your public page. Up to 600 characters.
profile.emailHint: To change your email, contact Photnoo support.
profile.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number such as 01012345678 or +201012345678.
profile.phoneTaken: Another account uses this phone number.

public.title: Public page
public.description: Your handle is the address of your portfolio and store.
public.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, 3 to 30 characters.

reasons.characters: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or number.
reasons.reserved: This handle is reserved. Choose another.
reasons.taken: Someone else has this handle. Try another.

public.linksHint: Shown on your public page. Paste the full address of each profile.
public.invalidUrl: Enter a full web address, e.g. https://example.com

branding.title: Client galleries
branding.description: Your logo and theme appear on the password screen and at the top of every gallery you share.
branding.logoHint: JPEG or PNG, up to 15 MB. A logo on a plain background reads best.
branding.noLogo: No logo yet. Clients see your initials.
branding.removeLogoBody: Clients see your initials instead until you upload a new one.
branding.themeHint: Dark suits evening events and moody work; light suits everything else.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the app and of the emails Photnoo sends you.
language.label: Preferred language

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose what Photnoo tells you about. Payments, uploads and plan reminders are always on.
notifications.firstOpen: A client opens a gallery for the first time
notifications.fullDownload: A client downloads a whole gallery
notifications.byEmail: Also send me these by email
notifications.byEmailHint: In-app notifications always appear in the bell.

security.title: Security
security.description: Change your password. Use at least 10 characters that you don't use anywhere else.
security.newHint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords and your email address.
security.logoutOthers: Log out on all other devices
security.changedLoggedOut: Your password is changed and {count, plural, one {# other device was} other {# other devices were}} logged out.
security.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
security.wrongCurrent: Your current password is not right.
security.weak: This password is too easy to guess. Avoid common passwords, repeated characters and your email address, and use one different from your current password.

image.tooLarge: This image is over 15 MB. Choose a smaller one.
image.type: Upload a JPEG or PNG image.
image.unreadable: This image could not be read. Export a new copy and try again.
image.failed: The image did not upload. Try again.
